piano-practice-tempo-ladder-metronome:
Practise with a metronome

The tempo ladder

Start slow
Pick the tempo where you play it perfectly, even if that is 50.
3 clean runs
Play the passage three times in a row with no mistakes.
Then +4 bpm
Nudge the metronome up one step and repeat.
Mistake? Step down
Go back 4 bpm. Tomorrow you will start higher.

Practise smarter

Chunking: fix the hard bars first

An 8-bar piece. Bars 5 and 6 keep going wrong.

① Hard bars first
② Add a bar each side
③ Bars 1 to 4

STEP 1
Find the hard bars
Play through once and circle the bars that break.
STEP 2
Slow, hands separately
Then hands together, at a tempo you can manage.
STEP 3
Grow the chunk
Add a bar on each side so the joins are smooth.
STEP 4
Link and overlap
Finish each chunk on the first note of the next.
